reviews.text: My dog loved it !
Elsi is the best, you can see she loves what she does and she does an amazing job with the puppies. Coucou is always happy to see Elsi and Angie

Elsi has been looking after my dog Sebastian for a little over a year now and she's been amazing! I've used Elsi for daycare, grooming, and boarding and Sebastian always has the best time. I'm so grateful I found a place where my dog feels safe and happy! I've recommended Elsi to everyone that I know and will continue recommending her!!

Could not ask for a better place for our dog, whether it is for daycare or boarding when we are out of town. Elsi balances professionalism with her sincere love for the animals she cares for. We feel so lucky to have found her!

Elsi is AMAZING! She makes my shy little pup feel at home and safe and he loves his visits. I also love that she gives updates throughout his time there. All these small dogs are in wonderful hands with Elsi <3

Our mini schnauzer is always happy when getting dropped off at Pawsitive Vibes. I can tell Elsi is very loving and caring to small dogs that enjoy cuddling in a cozy place. She always keep us updated on how our dog is doing throughout the day by sending photos and videos. The attached photo is taken by Elsi at the daycare. We also find the location convenient for people work in the financial district like us. It's only 15-min walk from Union Station. Highly recommend it to people who have small dogs. 🐕

Elsi did a fantastic job taking care of my dog tonight. We were just looking for evening care for our dog so that we could attend a show close by. We live out of town. Elsi was quick to respond to all of my messages, very easy to deal with and Gibson was super happy when we picked him up. We will definitely use her again!

We have been so lucky to meet Elsi and Pawsitive Daycare!

When we moved to Toronto, I was looking for a place where my beloved Macarena (our miniature Dachshund) would truly feel at home. From the moment we met Elsi, we knew it was the right place.

Maca has now stayed at Pawsitive Daycare for several days, and she has had the best time! She's been surrounded by love and care, cozy sofas and blankets, tasty treats, and so much affection from Elsi.

One of the things we appreciate the most is that Elsi always keeps us updated with messages and adorable photos of Maca enjoying her day, which gives us so much peace of mind.

If you're looking for a daycare where your dog will be treated like family, with personalized care and lots of love, **this is the place!** We couldn't recommend it more. ❤️🐾

Sage always looks forward to her time at Pawsitive Vibes Toronto. She gets to meet her dog friends, cuddle with Elsi, and feel at home. It gives us peace of mind knowing Sage is in good hands and well taken cared of while we’re at work.

Highly recommend Pawsitive Vibes Toronto.

My baby girl Stella has always been a very anxious pup when it comes to grooming and absolutely hates being brushed. Elsi and the team have been incredibly patient and supportive, helping Stella gradually become more comfortable with both grooming and brushing.

She has improved so much, and I truly appreciate how Elsi helps us stay on track with regular grooming appointments so Stella can continue building positive experiences.

If your puppy is anxious about grooming or you’re looking for a groomer who genuinely cares, I can’t recommend Elsi and the team enough. They are the absolute best!

Thank you for always being there for Stella and me. We appreciate everything you do and are so grateful to have found you. ❤️

Elsi has been absolutely wonderful with my pup, Finn! He's a bit reactive and thrives in smaller, thoughtfully managed groups with similar sized pups, and Elsi has created the perfect environment for him. She sends plenty of updates and makes sure he gets lots of cuddles. It's clear she genuinely cares about every dog in her care. I would recommend Elsi in a heartbeat!

My boyfriend and I brought our puppy for his first ever groom to Pawsitive Vibes. We were quite nervous, as any normal first time puppy owners would be, but Elsi made the entire process super transparent and smooth. She is super responsive and answered any questions we had! She was constantly sending pictures and updates the whole time which was so reassuring. Not only do we love Pawsitive Vibes Grooming but our puppy Roofus also loves it there! We brought him back again and he was so excited to see Elsi which is always a great sign. As long as we are in Toronto, this is the only place we will bring Roofus for grooming 🙂

We are so incredibly happy that we found Pawsitive Vibes! Finding a place that provides specialized, home-like care for dogs is rare, but what truly sets them apart is how kind, genuine, and caring the team is.

They treat every dog like family, and it gives us complete peace of mind knowing Whiskey is in such loving hands. They also offer grooming services, and we were beyond impressed. Whiskey looked incredible afterward—his haircut was exactly what we asked for, and the attention to detail and care was exceptional.

You can tell Elsi and her team genuinely love what they do, and it shows in every interaction. Whether you have a young puppy or a senior dog with special needs, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them. If you're looking for someone you can completely trust with your pup, Pawsitive Vibes is the place to go. We truly can't say enough wonderful things about them!

I’ve been leaving my dog with Elsi for a while now and every experience has been absolutely amazing. He always comes back happy, calm, and clearly well cared for.

What I really appreciate is how much attention she gives to the dogs individually he doesn’t just stay there, he actually socializes with other dogs and gets plenty of playtime and interaction. It’s made a big difference in his confidence and behavior around other dogs.

She also goes above and beyond, like even throwing him a birthday party, which was such a sweet and thoughtful touch. It really shows how much she genuinely cares about the dogs she looks after.

I always feel completely at ease leaving him with her knowing he’s safe, happy, and having a great time. Highly recommend Elsi!
Elsi is amazing! Our dog loves going to daycare, she always has great communication and sends the cutest photos throughout the day. Couldn’t recommend her more!

Elsi was amazing!! I was visiting Canada from the U.S. and was nervous about leaving my dogs with someone new, but she made the whole experience easy and stress free.

She was great with communication, sending updates throughout the day, and my dogs were happy, comfortable, and clearly had a great time.

I would absolutely recommend Elsi to anyone looking for a caring and trustworthy dog sitter! I wouldn't hesitate to book with her again! 🐶 ✨
Bimba and Nina love Elsi, they both stay with her for day care and boarding and are always so happy to get here and meet their friends ❤️
Moonie made so many fur friends ever since we started going to PAWSITIVE! Elsi and her mom are amazing to our fur babies

I can't recommend Elsi enough! I started sending my dog Ruby to daycare with her last year, and she loves it so much.

Elsi is super communicative and sends updates throughout the day, which I really appreciate. Ruby is so well taken care of here  - every morning, she's SO excited to be dropped off. If you're looking for someone trustworthy, who really loves dogs and will take care of yours - you should definitely check out Pawsitive Vibes :)
Elsie always takes such great care of Oscar, we’ve been with her for a few years and he adores her and the crew. Highly recommend!

I couldn’t be happier with Pawsitive vibe and services provided by Elsi's team. From the moment we started coming here, it’s been clear that the owner truly cares about the dogs and runs the business with a strong sense of responsibility and professionalism. It gives me real peace of mind knowing my dog is in such capable and attentive hands.

Communication has also been outstanding. I always feel well-informed, whether it’s updates during boarding or quick responses to questions. It’s obvious they prioritize keeping pet owners in the loop, which makes a big difference.

Most importantly, my dog absolutely loves it here. The excitement every time we arrive says it all! It’s such a relief to know my dog is not just being looked after, but genuinely happy and comfortable. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring environment for their pet.

Tried both daycare and grooming and couldn’t be happier. My dog felt so comfortable right away, and I really appreciated all the updates throughout the day. Elsi and the team were so kind and attentive, which made the whole experience feel easy and reassuring. Claudia did such a great job with the groom, we loved the final result. We’ll definitely be back!

Our Poppy is a shy, timid rescue, so we were specifically looking for something less commercial and more homey, and we got so lucky finding Elsi.
We were definitely nervous about daycare at first, but turns out… Poppy LOVES it!! She actually gets excited to go every week and has made little doggy friends!! Elsi is the sweetest. She’s so gentle and patient with Poppy, and there’s always something fun and enriching going on. And she takes the BEST photos of Poppy!
We trust Elsi completely with Poppy, and I’d 100% recommend her to anyone looking for a daycare :)

My dog Juno is always really excited to go back to Pawsitive Vibes and see Elsi! She provides such a comforting and loving space for all the pets she cares for. Elsi administers all my dog’s meds with no issues and sends daily picture updates which always puts my mind at ease. Juno loves to go back for daycare and play in the pit!! Would recommend Elsi & Pawsitive Vibes to any pet parent in a heartbeat.

If you have an anxious pup, Elsi is the sitter for you. She is so accommodating and patient with our Dobby; he’s genuinely happy to be with her. Her regular updates keep us at ease, and he always comes back from his stays in high spirits. We’re so grateful to have found her!

I've been really happy with Elsi looking after my dog (Eevee), and I'd highly recommend her.

From the very first meeting, she wasn't just going through the motions. She asked questions and genuinely wanted to make sure Eevee would be comfortable and well taken care of.

When I had to leave Eevee with her for a whole week, Elsi sent me regular updates the entire time, which made being away so much easier. But what really got me was coming home, Eevee was completely herself. Normally it takes her a few days to settle back into her routine after being away, but not this time. That said everything.

Elsi also does Eevee's grooming, and the same care shows every single time. She always comes home looking beautiful.

If you're looking for someone who genuinely loves what she does and treats your dog like her own, look no further.
Kilo always has such a calm and caring time at daycare and grooming. Overall, I could not ask for a better overall experience for her at Pawsitive Vibes or recommend Elsi and her team more!

DAYCARE REVIEW 🐾🐾🐾

We’ve had such a great experience with Pawsitive Vibes Toronto! Cookie absolutely loves spending time there with his friends, and it gives us peace of mind knowing he’s happy and well cared for while we’re at work. The photo and video updates always make our day—they’re such a nice touch. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a trustworthy and caring dog daycare!

My experience with Elsi has truly been a perfect match for my Mia. She is incredibly caring, attentive, and loving with her. Thanks to Elsi, Mia has made so many new puppy friends, and while she’s having all that fun, she’s also being pampered with amazing grooming services that keep her clean and well cared for.

I can’t recommend Elsi enough—she has such a calm, nurturing presence and treats every fur baby like her own. Thank you, Elsi, for always being there during the most crucial times and for consistently going above and beyond to care for Mia. It means more than I can say ❤️
Elsi takes great care of Mia during her stay and Mia has a ton of fun meeting all her friends! Highly recommend Elsi and team!
Elsi is reliable, caring, and truly attentive with every pet. You can tell she treats them like her own. Can’t recommend her enough!

My dog has been going to Pawsitive Vibes for daycare and boarding for over 1.5years, and she just loves it there! She gets very eager when we are near the entrance door and is always super excited to greet Elsi. Our dog loves cuddling with Elsi and socializing with the dogs. The environment is thoughtfully curated with fun activities (Valentine's photoshoot, ballpit) and Elsi is very attentive to each dog's personality!

Elsi is accommodating and listens to any concerns we have. We always receive multiple updates during the daycare visit and a verbal summary during pick up - we appreciate this very much!

Highlights of Pawsitive Vibes daycare include music lessons (yes, the dogs listen to classical music!) and Elsi's beautiful photos 😊

I highly recommend this dog caregiver. They were professional, caring, and kept me updated with messages and photos. My dog was happy, relaxed, and clearly well taken care of. I would definitely trust them again.

Our pup absolutely LOVES Elsi and the Pawsitive Vibes team! She has been going to Elsi since she was a puppy (now 1 years old) and even though she’s usually shy around people, she absolutely lights up and instantly becomes happier when she sees Elsi. The Pawsitive Vibes team always takes the absolute best care of our pup and ensures she always has the happiest experience. I wouldn’t trust my dog with any other daycare! We love working with Elsi and always appreciate her communication, consistent updates, and love for our pup 💛🐾

We’ve been sending our dog, Oli, to Positive Vibes Care for daycare and boarding for the past three years, and we couldn’t be happier with our experience.

Every time we even pass by the building, Oli gets so excited—which says everything. He always comes back home happy, which gives us so much reassurance that he’s genuinely enjoying his time there, whether it’s for daycare or a longer boarding stay. It’s clear he feels comfortable and well cared for.

He also gets along so well with all his little friends there, which makes it even more special for us to see him socializing and having fun.

One of our favorite parts is the updates we receive—Elsi always sends the cutest photos, and we truly appreciate it. It gives us such peace of mind knowing that our little dog is having the best day, whether we’re at work or away from home.

We’re so grateful to have found a place we trust this much. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a caring and reliable dog daycare or boarding service.

We use Pawsitive Vibes for daycare and absolutely love it! We were really looking for something more cozy and calm versus a traditional daycare with tons of dogs, and this has been perfect. We especially love the personalized, intimate care. Our dog is always so comfortable and happy there. Highly recommended!

Really good experience overall at Pawsitive Vibes. We’ve been using their daycare services and my dog is always excited to go and see Elsi and his friends. He seems super comfortable and always comes home happy. You can tell they care. Thank you Elsi and the team!

I can’t recommend Pawsitive Vibes enough! You can really tell how much love and care goes into everything Elsi does. From the moment you drop your dog off, you feel completely at ease knowing they’re in a safe, clean, and home-like environment. It’s not just a business, it genuinely feels like a second home for your pet. 100% recommend

We had been looking for a cozy, more personal setup for our cockapoo and came across Pawsitive Vibes - we wanted to try it right away and weren’t disappointed.

We’ve been using both daycare and grooming services, and both have been phenomenal. The care our dog receives is on another level. Elsi and her team truly care for dogs as if they are their own.

It gives us so much peace of mind knowing she’s so well taken care of while we’re at work and getting to socialize in such a calm environment. We're so glad we found Pawsitive Vibes!

Elsi is always our first call when we need an extra pair of hands to help with our dog whether it's for daycare or overnight boarding. When we first came across Pawsitive Vibes and spoke to Elsi at a high-level about her services, she really reiterated the fact that she has a carefully curated environment where all dogs under her care feel safe. This put us at ease and this was further supported when we met Elsi for the first time and boarded our dog with Elsi for over a week. Our dog fell instantly in love with Elsi and more importantly, felt safe. Elsi has and continues to work at fostering a really unique and special environment for the dogs that come to Pawsitive Vibes and this is not something that can be replicated or that you will find elsewhere. Pawsitive Vibes is a safe haven for dogs. It's calm, cozy, and of course, has lots of stimulating toys to play with. The daycare groups are intentionally small and every dog receives an overwhelming amount of love, affection, and stimulation from Elsi. They are not left to run around in a basement with 30 other dogs (of varying sizes) and random daycare attendants sitting there aimlessly. Elsi goes above and beyond with her communication, sending frequent photos and text updates, even when your dog is only there for a few short hours. The photos and texts from Elsi will do you heart so good knowing your dog is thriving and just as happy in a home that is not their own. Elsi is always quick to respond and extremely accommodating (even with last minute bookings). Moreover, Elsi has a wonderful team of trustworthy walkers and sitters to handle all her overflow. Elsi has a high standard for care and has clearly trained her team members in order to ensure that they adhere to her high standard of care. We have stopped sending our dog to a conventional doggy daycare ever since finding Elsi, as her environment suits our dog perfectly. Moreover, there is no one else we call when we require boarding (nor is there anyone we trust as much as Elsi) and even in a pinch, Elsi will always make sure that should we require boarding services, our dog will be cared for under Pawsitive Vibes. Elsi loves our dog like he's her own and our dog loves Elsi like he is an extension of her family. It does my heart good to have my dog drag me straight to Elsi's door when I drop him off for boarding or daycare and as a pet owner, there is no greater or more comforting feeling than knowing your dog is safe and being cared for. Having someone love your dog like it's their own is the added bonus. The services Pawsitive Vibes offers are something every dog owner needs and it is worth sending your dog there whether or not you live in the downtown core. I cannot say enough good things about Elsi and what she has worked so hard to create (and our pup agrees)!

Elsi is amazing with dogs and truly cares about every pup she looks after. Her doggy daycare is such a welcoming, loving place, and you can tell she puts so much heart into what she does. She’s attentive, kind, and makes both dogs and owners feel comfortable and cared for. She also offers grooming, which is such a great bonus, and the dogs always come back looking and feeling great. It’s so nice to have someone you can genuinely trust with your pet. I would highly recommend Elsi to anyone looking for a caring and reliable doggy daycare.
